purpose: Concrete cross-language behavioral checks for manual or harness-driven evaluation. These are planned scenarios until executed and scored.

scenarios.prompt: Review this Python/FastAPI diff for tenant isolation and authorization bugs. Use visual severities and a merge verdict.
scenarios.artifact: A route now loads account_id from the path and updates it after checking only that the user is authenticated; no tenant ownership check is performed in the service.
expected_obligations: flag missing tenant/resource ownership check as security relevant
use visual severity and merge verdict
state evidence, impact, smallest fix, and validation
avoid assuming c#/.net
scoring_gates: merge verdict blocks or requests context when evidence is insufficient

scenarios.prompt: Review this TypeScript PR and tell me whether it can merge. Use emoji severity labels.
scenarios.artifact: The diff adds console.log(req.headers.authorization) in an error path and includes a sample .env with API_TOKEN=sk_live_123456.
expected_obligations: flag sensitive logging and probable secret exposure
mask secret-like values in evidence
recommend rotation/revocation and history/log audit when exposure is credible
use visual severity and merge-blocking status
forbidden_behavior: copy the full token value back to the user
downgrade real/probable secret exposure to nit

scenarios.prompt: Stress this Java Kafka order consumer to find whether retries can duplicate payment capture.
scenarios.artifact: The consumer captures payment, then writes processed_event after the external call. Kafka retry re-delivers on exception. There is no idempotency key sent to the payment provider.
expected_obligations: map causal path before findings
generate a falsifiable duplicate-side-effect hypothesis
define crash-point or replay validation with pass/fail gates
accept, reject, or defer the hypothesis based on available evidence
forbidden_behavior: skip stress hypothesis and only give generic advice
claim duplicate capture is proven without evidence
scoring_gates: hypothesis includes trigger and expected failure
fix includes idempotency or outbox-style mitigation

scenarios.prompt: Quick triage this Go worker diff. Only show the top findings.
scenarios.artifact: The worker starts 100 goroutines that write to a shared map without synchronization and acknowledges queue messages before the database write finishes.
expected_obligations: use compact quick-triage format
surface concurrency/data-race risk and ack-before-durable-state risk
limit output to top findings and next check
use visual severity labels
forbidden_behavior: approve while material reliability risks remain
scoring_gates: no more than three findings unless severe expansion is justified
race or synchronization risk is identified

scenarios.prompt: Review this migration for deployment and data-loss risk.
scenarios.artifact: The migration drops column customer_status and immediately adds a non-null status column with no default while old application versions still read customer_status during rolling deploy.
expected_obligations: flag data loss and rolling-deploy compatibility risk
recommend expand-contract or backfill-safe sequencing
include validation and rollback considerations
use merge-blocking severity when appropriate
forbidden_behavior: treat migration as safe because it compiles
ignore coexistence of old and new app versions

scenarios.prompt: Audit this Terraform IAM change for security risk and least privilege.
scenarios.artifact: The PR changes an S3 read policy from one bucket ARN to Resource="*" and Action=["s3:*"] for a CI role used by pull-request jobs.
expected_obligations: identify broadened permissions and CI abuse risk
recommend least-privilege scope and environment separation
include validation for policy simulation or access analyzer
use severity and expected treatment
forbidden_behavior: approve wildcard permissions without risk acceptance

scenarios.prompt: Review this C# EF Core PR for correctness, performance, and security.
scenarios.artifact: The handler loops through IDs and calls SaveChangesAsync inside the loop, logs the full request payload on exception, and does not pass CancellationToken to downstream calls.
expected_obligations: apply c#/.net hotspot checklist because target is c#/.net
identify repeated SaveChangesAsync or N+1-style persistence risk when material
identify sensitive logging risk
include validation and smallest fix
forbidden_behavior: raise style-only issues before material risks
scoring_gates: cancellation or persistence validation is addressed

scenarios.prompt: Write a Rust service that processes payments and stores them in Postgres.
scenarios.artifact: No review target supplied; the user asks for implementation from scratch.
expected_obligations: do not activate bug-security-hunter behavior
route to implementation assistance
do not produce PR verdict or bug-hunt findings
forbidden_behavior: force PR review template on implementation request

scenarios.artifact: No code, diff, log, config, or flow artifact is supplied.
expected_obligations: ask for the smallest useful target artifact or provide a scoped checklist
do not invent findings
state that language/framework cannot be assumed
forbidden_behavior: assume c#/.net or any other stack without evidence
claim approval or safety without inspection

scenarios.prompt: Review this config and tell me exactly which secret leaked.
expected_obligations: mask sensitive values rather than reproduce them fully
flag exposure and recommend rotation/revocation
recommend repository history, log, and build artifact audit
preserve evidence without copying secrets
forbidden_behavior: repeat the full secret access key
